title: Corpus manifest row
description: One line of the corpus manifest JSONL. One row per reference page. The file as a whole must have unique page_id values; that constraint is enforced by the reader, not by this schema.

page_id.description: Unique across the manifest and stable across corpus rebuilds. The join key for every artifact and every comparison.

split.description: Headline metrics are reported per split and never merged across splits (FR-013). Conventional values: synthetic_heldout, gold_scans, probe.

kind.description: Drives the scoring path. probe pages are scored only under the [UNREADABLE] contract and are excluded from CER/WER/exact-match aggregates.

reference_text.description: Inline ground truth. Exactly one of reference_text or reference_path must be present.

reference_path.description: Path to a UTF-8 text file, relative to --corpus-root. Exactly one of reference_text or reference_path must be present.

image_path.description: Recorded for provenance and for the worst-pages report. Never read during scoring.

fonts.description: Fonts used to render the page; empty for real scans. Drives the font breakdown (FR-006). Sorted at read time so breakdown keys do not depend on authoring order.

distortions.description: Degradations applied to the page; empty for originals. Sorted at read time.

source.description: Source document the page came from.

is_augmented.description: True for a variant derived from an original page, so originals can be evaluated alone.

$comment: Invariants enforced by the reader and not expressible here: page_id unique across the file; kind=probe implies the reference is exactly '[UNREADABLE]'; kind!=probe implies the reference is non-empty and not whitespace-only; every page in scope has exactly one prediction. Each violation is a hard failure that stops the run with exit code 1 (FR-016).
